prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” broker, but **BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for a self-employed person in the Kansas City area. It specifically serves self-employed people and 1099 contractors, compares Marketplace and private plans, and has an office in North Kansas City. Call **(816) 205-4664** or visit [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/health-insurance/).

Also consider **Apollo Health Insurance**, based in Lee’s Summit, which says it compares individual plans across carriers and helps check doctors, prescriptions, and subsidy eligibility. Visit [Apollo](https://apollo-insurance.com/health-insurance-broker-kansas-city/).

When you speak with either broker, ask whether they’ll compare **all available ACA Marketplace plans**, check your doctors and prescriptions, and estimate your eligibility for premium tax credits. Marketplace subsidies are generally tied to Marketplace coverage, so be cautious about choosing an off-Marketplace or short-term plan before comparing the trade-offs. Broker services are often free to you, but confirm that directly.
